sections.title: Calendar import
sections.text:
External calendars (such as Google Calendar, or a calendar from another Moodle site) can be imported into Moodle's calendar via the iCal standard.
To import a calendar via .ics file or URL,
# Add a calendar block to your page
# Click on the month to enter the calendar.
# At the bottom of the page, click the button 'Manage subscriptions'
# Click the button 'Manage subscriptions'
# Give the calendar subscription a name and either enter a URL or upload an .ics file
# Select 'Type of event'
# Click the Add button
A user who has permission to add course or group events, such as a teacher, can import a calendar and create course or group events.
Similarly, a user who has permission to add site events, such as an administrator, can import a calendar and create site events.
Events imported via URL cannot be edited. Events imported via .ics file can be edited. If the .ics file calendar subscription is subsequently deleted, any edited events are also deleted.

sections.title: Preference settings
sections.text: Both the daily detail screen and the monthly detail screen have the Preferences button in the upper right. Here you can set the time format, first day of the week, number of events to show in the calendar block, days to look forward for events and if the filters on this calendar should be saved as the default for all calendars.

sections.title: Site administration settings
sections.text: The following settings can be changed by a site administrator in ''Administration > Appearance > Calendar'':

sections.title: Calendar type
sections.text: The admin can choose a default calendar type for the whole site here. Individual users can override this in the course settings or in their user profile.

sections.title: Admins see all
sections.text: Whether admins see all calendar events or just those that apply to themselves.

sections.title: Time display format
sections.text: Whether a 12 or 24 hour format is used. This setting can be overridden by user preferences.

sections.title: Start of week
sections.text: Default is Sunday.

sections.title: Weekend days
sections.text: Weekend days are shown in a different colour.

sections.title: Days and events to look ahead
sections.text: For determining how many events are listed in the Upcoming Events block. If the Upcoming Events block becomes too long you can reduce the number of days and events to lookahead.

sections.title: Calendar export days to look ahead and back
sections.text: A custom range of dates, such as a school term or year, may be set as a calendar export option.

sections.title: Calendar export salt
sections.text: The calendar export salt is a random string of characters used for improving of security of authentication tokens used for exporting of calendars.

sections.title: Calendar permissions
sections.text:
*moodle/calendar:manageentries
*moodle/calendar:manageownentries
*moodle/calendar:managegroupentries
The Calendar editor role may be used to enable users to add course or site events to the calendar.
[[Category:Site administration]]

sections.title: See also
sections.text: *[[:dev:Calendar types|Calendar types in Developer Docs]]

sections.title: Can not log in
sections.text: If you are having problems logging into a Moodle site then you should check a couple of things.

sections.title: Correct username and password
sections.text:
Have you typed the Username and Password in correctly, exactly as it was given to you?
:Example: your name is Chris Smith'''e''', but the username you were given is
::csmith  
::chris.smith
:Example: your name is Chris O'Brien, but the username you were given is
::cobrien
*Solutions: Look closely. Or ask your teacher or site administrator to change your user name.  Or ask them to login using the name and password you were given.

sections.title: Case sensitive
sections.text:
Remember that the username and password can be case sensitive.
:Moodle is different than 
::'''m'''oodle  
::m'''OO'''dlE

sections.title: Alpha or numeric
sections.text:
Remember to look closely at what you were given.   
:moodle is different than
::mood'''1'''e (number one instead of L)
::m'''00'''dle  (number zero instead of O )
Solutions: use a view zoom feature to increase the size of the fonts so the difference between a O and 0 or l and 1 can be seen.

sections.title: Caps lock key on
sections.text:
Is the Caps-Lock key on your keyboard ON? You could be typing CHRIS instead of chris.
*Solution: check the caps-lock light on your keyboard.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.text:
Cookies must be turned on in your browser. 
*Solution: this setting sometimes can be found in your browser menu bar under tools>options>privacy.

sections.title: Correct Moodle
sections.text:
Are you on the right Moodle?  Many Moodle login screens look the same. 
*Solution: look at the URL address bar in your browser.   
:<nowiki>http://localhost </nowiki>  is different than
:<nowiki>http://ProductionMoodle.org</nowiki>

sections.title: Do you have an user name
sections.text:
Has someone with authority issued you a Username and Password?
*Solution: Try lost password link or contact your teacher or site administrator.

sections.title: Lost password link
sections.text: You may be able to follow the 'lost password' link in the log on block of the 'send me details via email' button.

sections.title: Be kind
sections.text: Sometimes mistakes happen. Tell your site administrator you went over this checklist and you could not login.

sections.text: *[[Administration_FAQ#I_have_forgotten_the_admin_password | Administration FAQ - Forgotten the admin password]]

sections.title: Capabilities/block/trouble ticket:submitticket
sections.text:
This permission allows the user to submit a trouble ticket.
* Defaults
** Administrator: Allow
** Course Creator: Allow
** Teacher: Allow
** Non-editing Teacher: Allow
** Student: Allow
** Guest: Prevent
** Authenticated User: Allow
* Risks
** Spam: User could send spam to site users or others

sections.title: Capabilities/booktool/exportimscp:export
sections.text:
*This allows a user to export a book as an IMS content package
*Books exported as IMS content packages can be added to existing books using [[Book settings#Importing_chapters|Importing chapters]]  (where Type is set to 'Each folder represents one chapter')
*This capability is not set for any of the default roles
[[Category:Capabilities|Book]]
[[Category:IMS content package]]

sections.title: Capabilities/booktool/importhtml:import
sections.text:
*This allows a user to import chapters of a book
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
*This capability is intended for trusted users only, it should not be given to students.
[[Category:Capabilities|Book]]

sections.title: Capabilities/booktool/print:print
sections.text:
*This allows a user to print a book
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher, student and guest
[[Category:Capabilities|Book]]

sections.title: Capabilities/communication/matrix:moderator
sections.text:
This allows a user to moderate a Matrix room created in a course.
This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/contenttype/h5p:access
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to access H5P content in the Content bank.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, course creator and teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/contenttype/h5p:upload
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to upload new H5P content to the Content bank.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, course creator and teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/contenttype/h5p:useeditor
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to create or edit H5P content in the Content bank.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, course creator and teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/category:config
sections.text:
*This allows a user to add or delete the Category enrolments plugin to a course via ''Administration > Course administration > Users > Enrolment methods''
*The default roles of Manager and Teacher have this capability set to allow
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment|Course]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/category:synchronised
sections.text:
*This capability is for use with the Category enrolments enrolment plugin. It allows users with a particular role, such as student, to be enrolled in all courses in a category.
*This capability is not set for any of the default roles.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Category enrolments for details of how to use this capability
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/cohort:config
sections.text:
*This allows a user to add or delete the Cohort sync enrolment plugin to a course via ''Administration > Course administration > Users > Enrolment methods'' (provided that it has been enabled by admin in ''Administration > Site administration > Plugins > Enrolments > Manage enrol plugins'') 
*The default roles of Manager and[[ Teacher]] have this set to allow. 
The required capabilities for setting up a cohort sync is: 
*enrol/cohort:config in the course context 
The required capabilities for manually enrolling cohort members:
*enrol/manual:enrol in course context 
Additional capability that is required to access the invisible cohorts is:
*moodle/cohort:view in the same context as cohort

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Cohorts
*Cohort sync
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/database:config
sections.text:
*This allows a user to add or delete an External database enrolment plugin to a course via ''Administration > Course administration > Users > Enrolment methods''
*The default roles of Manager and Teacher have this capability set to allow
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment|Course]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/dynamicrule:config
sections.text:
*This allows a user to configure the [[Dynamic rules#Courses|"Enrol users into a course" and "Unenrol users from a course" actions]], respectively in a Dynamic Rule
*This capability is allowed for the default role of Administrator

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/dynamicrule:enrol
sections.text:
* This allows a user to use the [[Dynamic_rules#Courses|"Enrol users into a course" action with a Dynamic Rule]]
* This capability is allowed for the default role of Manager

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/dynamicrule:unenrol
sections.text:
* This allows a user to use the [[Dynamic rules#Courses|"Unenrol users from a course" action with a Dynamic Rule]]
* This capability is allowed for the default role of Manager

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/fee:config
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to configure (including delete) an Enrolment on payment instance for a course.
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only.
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/fee:manage
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to manage users enrolled through Enrolment on payment.
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher.
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/fee:unenrol
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to unenrol users enrolled through Enrolment on payment.
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only.
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/fee:unenrolself
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to who enrolled through Enrolment on payment to unenrol themselves.
* This capability is not set for any of the default roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/guest:config
sections.text:
*This allows a user to add or delete the Guest access enrolment plugin to a course via ''Administration > Course administration > Users > Enrolment methods'' (provided that it has been enabled by admin in ''Administration > Site administration > Plugins > Enrolments > Manage enrol plugins'')
*The default roles of manager and teacher have this capability set to allow.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Guest access
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment|Course]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/imsenterprise:config
sections.text:
*This allows a user to add or delete an IMS Enterprise enrolment plugin to a course via ''Administration > Course administration > Users > Enrolment methods''
*The default roles of manager and teacher have this capability set to allow
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment|Course]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/ldap:manage
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to manage LDAP enrolment via ''Settings > Site administration > Plugins > Manage enrol plugins''
*The default role of Manager has this set to allow
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/manual:config
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit the Manual enrolment method and set the default enrolment period and default role in ''Administration > Course administration > Users > Enrolment methods''
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/manual:enrol
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enrol other users into a course manually via ''Settings > Course administration > Users > Enrolled users''
*The default roles of manager and teacher have this capability set to allow.
*This allows users to see the “Enroll Users” button on the course Participants page

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Manual enrolment
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/manual:manage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage enrolled users in ''Settings > Course administration > Users > Enrolled users''
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of Manager and Teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Manual enrolment
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/manual:unenrol
sections.text:
*This allows a user to unenrol other users manually in ''Settings > Course administration > Users > Enrolled users''
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of Manager and Teacher
*This capability adds a trash can icon next to each participant of the Participants page

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Manual enrolment
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/manual:unenrolself
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manually unenrol themselves from a course in which they were previously manually enrolled via ''Course navigation > More >  Unenrol me from this course''
*This capability is not set for any of the default roles
*To allow students to unenrol themselves from courses which they were previously manually enrolled in, the capability must be set to "allow" for the student role via ''Administration > Site Administration > Users > Permissions > Define roles.''

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Manual enrolment
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/meta:config
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to configure (including delete) a Course meta link enrolment method
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/meta:selectaslinked
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to choose courses for a Course meta link
* This capability is allowed for the default role of Manager only and is not set for the default Teacher role
* To enable a teacher to choose courses for a Course meta link, they need to have this capability set to "allow" via ''Settings>Site Administration>Users>Permissions>Define roles'', alongside the capability  enrol:meta:config 
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/mnet:config
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to configure (including delete) MNet remote enrolments for a course in ''Administration > Course administration > Users > Enrolment methods''
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/paypal:config
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to configure (including delete) Paypal enrolment for a course in ''Administration > Course administration > Users > Enrolment methods''
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/paypal:manage
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to manage users enrolled through Paypal enrolment
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of Manager and Teacher 
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/paypal:unenrol
sections.text:
*This allows a user to unenrol other users who were enrolled via Paypal enrolment in ''Settings > Course administration > Users > Enrolled users''
*This capability is allowed for the default role of Manager only
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/paypal:unenrolself
sections.text:
*This allows a user to unenrol themselves from a course which they were enrolled in via Paypal enrolment in ''Settings > Course administration > Unenrol me from this course''
*This capability is not set for any of the default roles 
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrolment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/program:config
sections.text: * Allows to configure program enrolment instances in Programs.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Moodle Workplace
* Programs

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/program:enrol
sections.text: * Allows to enrol users via Programs.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Moodle Workplace
* Programs

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/program:manage
sections.text: * Allows to manage users which have been enrolled via Programs.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Moodle Workplace
* Programs

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/program:unenrol
sections.text: * Allows to unenrol users which have been enrolled via Programs.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Moodle Workplace
* Programs

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/self:config
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to configure (including delete) Self enrolment for a course. 
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher.
*If using the Boost theme the capability can be changed from the gear menu in the Participants link, or in other themes from  ''Administration > Course administration > Users > Enrolment methods''.
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/self:enrolself
sections.text:
*This allows a user to self enrol in a course.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of authenticated user. It can be unset for the authenticated user role and allowed for particular roles to control who can self enrol in a course.
*This capability is new in Moodle 3.10 onwards.
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/self:holdkey
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to appear as the keyholder in a course where Self enrolment with an enrolment key is enabled.
*The capability is not set for any of the default roles.
*For more information about using this capability, please see Keyholder role.
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/self:manage
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user manage users enrolled through Self enrolment in ''Settings > Course administration > Users > Enrolled users''
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/self:unenrol
sections.text:
*This allows a user to unenrol other users who were enrolled via Self enrolment in ''Settings > Course administration > Users > Enrolled users''
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/enrol/self:unenrolself
sections.text:
*This allows a user to unenrol themselves from a course which they self-enrolled in
*This capability is allowed for the default role of student
[[Category:Capabilities|Enrol]]

sections.title: Capabilities/factor/capability:cannotpassfactor
sections.text:
* Users with this capability must use another factor in Multi-factor authentication to authenticate.
* This capability is not set for any of the default roles.
* The capability must be applied at system level by assigning users a system role.
For details of how this capability can be used, see the information about 'User capability' in Multi-factor authentication.
[[Category:Capabilities|Authentication]]

sections.title: Capabilities/format/page:addpages
sections.text:
This permission allows a user to add a new page to the flexpage course.
* Defaults
** Administrator: Allow
** Course Creator: Allow
** Teacher: Allow
** Non-editing Teacher: Not set
** Student: Not set
** Guest: Not set
** Authenticated User: Not set

sections.title: Capabilities/format/page:editpages
sections.text:
This permission allows a user to edit a page settings as well as modify what is displayed on the page.
* Defaults
** Administrator: Allow
** Course Creator: Allow
** Teacher: Allow
** Non-editing Teacher: Not set
** Student: Not set
** Guest: Not set
** Authenticated User: Not set

sections.title: Capabilities/format/page:managepages
sections.text:
This permission allows the user to change settings for pages via the manage page settings tab.
* Defaults
** Administrator: Allow
** Course Creator: Allow
** Teacher: Allow
** Non-editing Teacher: Not set
** Student: Not set
** Guest: Not set
** Authenticated User: Not set

sections.title: Capabilities/format/page:viewpagesettings
sections.text:
This permission allows the user to view the page's hide and show settings but no other settings for the page.  This also allows a user to view hidden pages.
* Defaults
** Administrator: Allow
** Course Creator: Allow
** Teacher: Allow
** Non-editing Teacher: Not set
** Student: Not set
** Guest: Not set
** Authenticated User: Not set

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeexport/ods:publish
sections.text:
* This allows a user to publish OpenOffice grade exports i.e. set up a URL for accessing exported grades without having to login to Moodle. 
*This capability is set to allow for the default role of manager.
Note: Grade publishing is disabled by default. It can be enabled by checking the gradepublishing box in ''Administration > Grades > Grade settings''.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grades]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeexport/ods:view
sections.text:
*This allows a user to use the OpenOffice grade export.
*This capability is set to allow for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeexport/txt:publish
sections.text:
* This allows a user to publish text file grade exports i.e. set up a URL for accessing exported grades without having to login to Moodle. 
*This capability is set to allow for the default role of manager.
Note: Grade publishing is disabled by default. It can be enabled by checking the gradepublishing box in ''Administration > Grades > Grade settings''.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeexport/txt:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to export grades as a text file.
*This capability is set to allow for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeexport/xls:publish
sections.text:
* This allows a user to publish Excel grade exports i.e. set up a URL for accessing exported grades without having to login to Moodle
* This capability is set to allow for the default role of manager only
Note: Grade publishing is disabled by default. It can be enabled by checking the gradepublishing box in ''Settings > Site administration > Grades > Grade settings''.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeexport/xls:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to use the Excel spreadsheet grade export
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeexport/xml:publish
sections.text:
* This allows a user to publish XML file grade exports i.e. set up a URL for accessing exported grades without having to login to Moodle
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
Note: Grade publishing is disabled by default. It can be enabled by checking the gradepublishing box in ''Settings > Site administration > Grades > Grade settings''.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeexport/xml:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to use the XML file grade export
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher 
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeimport/csv:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to import grades via CSV file
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeimport/direct:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to import grades by pasting from a spreadsheet
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeimport/xml:publish
sections.text:
* This allows a user to import grades by accessing a special URL
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradeimport/xml:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to import grades via XML file
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradereport/grader:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view the course Gradebook
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradereport/outcomes:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view the outcomes report.
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradereport/overview:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view their overview report.
* The default student role has this capability set to allow.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradereport/singleview:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view either all the grades of one single student or a single grade item for all students in Single view
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher 
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradereport/summary:view
sections.text:
This capability allows the user to view the new Grade summary report and is allowed by default for the roles of Manager, Teacher and Non-editing Teacher.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/gradereport/user:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view the user report, showing grades in the course
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher and student
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/message/airnotifier:managedevice
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage their registered mobile device for Mobile app notifications
*This capability is allowed for the default role of authenticated user
[[Category:Capabilities|Messaging]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:addattendees
sections.text: * This allows a user to [[Appointments#Booking a place for another user|add attendees]] to sessions in the Appointment activity.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:addinstance
sections.text: * This allows a user to create an appointment instance inside a course

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:configurecancellation
sections.text: * This allows the configuration of sign-up [[Appointments#Cancellation|cancellations]] when adding or editing an Appointment activity

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:editsessions
sections.text: *This allows a user to add attendees to an [[Appointments#Appointments and sessions|Appointment session]].

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:managecustomfields
sections.text:
* This allows a user to manage site-wide custom fields for appointment sessions.
* This capability is not allowed by default for any roles.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:overbook
sections.text: *This allows a user to sign-up to full sessions that don't have [[Appointments#Waitlisting|waitlisting]] enabled.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:removeattendees
sections.text: *This allows a user to remove attendees from an [[Appointments#Appointments and sessions|appointment session]].

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:signup
sections.text: * This allows a user to [[Appointments#Signing up|sign up]] to sessions in the Appointment activity.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:takeattendance
sections.text: *This allows a user to [[Appointments#Attendance|take attendance]] in an appointment session.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:view
sections.text: *This allows a user to view [[Appointments#Appointments and sessions|Appointment activities and sessions]].

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:viewattendees
sections.text: *This allows a user to view the [[Appointments#Attendance|attendance]] of attendees in the Appointment activity.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/appointment:viewcancellations
sections.text: *This allows a user to view [[Appointments#Cancellation|cancellations]] in an appointment session.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:addinstance
sections.text:
*This allows a user to add a new assignment to the course
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:editothersubmission
sections.text:
* This capability allows a teacher to edit or delete student assignment submissions.
* This capability is not set for any role.
* It must be set to 'Allow' by the administrator after careful consideration of possible consequences.
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:exportownsubmission
sections.text:
*This allows a user to export their own assignment submissions to a portfolio 
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher and student
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:grade
sections.text:
*This allows a user to see submissions, add comments to and grade assignments
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:manageallocations
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage markers allocated to assignment submissions
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:managegrades
sections.text:
*This allows a user to review and release grades for an Assignment
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:manageoverrides
sections.text:
*This allows a user manage Assignment overrides
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:receivegradernotifications
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to be notified of assignments submitted by students.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher.
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:releasegrades
sections.text:
*This allows a user to release grades for an Assignment
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:revealidentities
sections.text:
*This allows a user to reveal student identities when marking Assignment submissions
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:reviewgrades
sections.text:
*This capability is used within the marking workflow process and allows a user to use the marking workflow states "In Review" and "Ready for "Release" when marking an Assignment
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Capabilities/mod/assign:managegrades
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:showhiddengrader
sections.text:
*This allows a user to see the identity of a hidden Assignment grader
*This capability is available in Moodle 3.7 onwards and is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:submit
sections.text:
*This allows a user to submit an assignment
*This capability is allowed for the default role of student only
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:view
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view assignments
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher, student and guest
Assignment links on the course page and in the navigation are only displayed for users who have this capability.
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:viewblinddetails
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view student identities when Anonymous submissions is enabled for an Assignment activity. Participant numbers are also shown, enabling users to be cross referenced.
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* The capability View anonymous events in reports
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:viewgrades
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to view assignment grades and feedback (both text and uploaded files) without being able to change them.
* This capability is set to 'Allow' for managers, teachers and non-editing teachers and is not set for other roles.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Grade viewer role
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]
[[Es:Capabilities/mod/assign:viewgrades]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assign:viewownsubmissionsummary
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view the summary of their own submission.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of student only.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assignment:addinstance
sections.text:
*This allows a user to add an [https://docs.moodle.org/22/en/Assignment_module Assignment (2.2) activity] to the course
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
Note: The assignment activity module was completely rewritten in Moodle 2.3. It is recommended that this capability is removed from the role of teacher to avoid the confusion of two assignments being listed in the activity chooser.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Assignment upgrade tool
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assignment:exportownsubmission
sections.text:
*This allows a user to export their own submissions in the old [https://docs.moodle.org/22/en/Assignment_module Assignment (2.2) module] to a portfolio 
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher and student
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/assignment:grade
sections.text:
*This allows a user to grade assignments for the old [https://docs.moodle.org/22/en/Assignment_module Assignment (2.2) module]
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Assignment]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/cado:approve
sections.text:
This capability gives the ability to '''approve''' a generated CADO for release for view by students.
Upon approval, a CADO is no longer able to have its three text boxes or grouping edited in the CADO settings, though its name, restrictions and tags remain editable. 
See [[CADO_resource|CADO documentation]] for more information.
By default, the manager role includes this capability, the teacher role does not.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/cado:compare
sections.text:
This capability gives the ability to '''compare''' any generated CADO with any other generated CADO. A menu option 'Compare' appears in the CADO administration settings.
In a compare, differences between sections of a CADO are highlighted.  
See [[CADO_resource|CADO documentation]] for more information.
By default, the editing teacher and manager roles include this capability.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/cado:generate
sections.text:
This capability gives the ability to '''generate''' a CADO, after a CADO resource has been added to the course page, and when the user views the CADO.
See CADO documentation for more information.
By default, the editing teacher and manager roles include this capability.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/cado:view
sections.text:
This capability gives the ability to '''view''' any generated CADO that has been approved.
See [[CADO_resource|CADO documentation]] for more information.
By default, the following roles include this capability:
* guest
* student
* non editing teacher
* editing teacher
* manager

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/forum:allowforcesubscribe
sections.text:
*This allows a user to be subscribed automatically to forums where subscription is automatic or forced.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of teacher, non-editing teacher and student. It is not set for the role of manager.
The following table summarises the effect this capability has on the various forum subscription methods:
{| class="wikitable"
! rowspan="2" | Subscription Mode
! colspan="2" | Effect of capability...
|-
! on initial subscription
! on subscription changes
|-
| Force subscription
| Users with the capability are subscribed
| It is not possible to change subscription
|-
| Auto subscription
| Users with the capability are subscribed
| Any user can choose to subscribe or unsubscribe at any point
|-
| Optional subscription
| The capability has no effect
| Any user can choose to subscribe or unsubscribe at any point
|-
| Subscription disabled
| The capability has no effect
| It is not possible to change subscription
|}

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Forum module
[[Category:Capabilities|Forum]]

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/forum:splitdiscussions
sections.text:
*This allows a user to split forum discussions. Splitting a discussion means that beginning with the post selected and going to the end of that thread, the posts are cut from the current discussion topic and put into a newly created discussion topic. If discussion has strayed away from the original topic, splitting the discussion can provide new attention and space for the tangent discussion while keeping the original discussion on topic.
*This capability is allowed for default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher 
[[Category:Capabilities|Forum]]

(By default a Q and A forum requires students to post once before viewing other students' postings. After the initial posting, students can view and respond to others' postings. This feature allows equal initial posting opportunity among all students, thus encouraging original and independent thinking.)
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/quiz:attempt
sections.text:
* This allows a user to attempt quizzes.
* This capability is allowed for the student role only.
* Guest users can never attempt quizzes, even if you give guests the mod/quiz:attempt capability. This is because all information about a user's progress through the quiz must be stored in the database associated with the user doing the attempt, and each user can only have one attempt open at a time. Since all guest users in Moodle share a single user account, letting guests attempt quizzes would just cause a big mess where different guest users' actions would conflict with each other. Therefore, people logged in as guest are never allowed to attempt quizzes.
* It is currently not possible to allow a user to preview AND attempt quizzes. To enable a user to attempt quizzes, mod/quiz:attempt should be allowed and mod/quiz:preview should be not set.

sections.text:
Index
Allows accessing to controls and screens for updating and adding project requirements. Not giving such capability to students will give teacher authority to define the project requirement set.

sections.title: Legacy roles settings
sections.text: Changing requirements is allowed as default for the whole site. Prohibiting or preventing such capability, for a given module within a given course is a local decision of the teacher/project manager.

sections.text:
Index

sections.title: Legacy roles settings

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/techproject:gradeproject
sections.text:
Index
Allows accessing to grading screens. Adding Capabilities/mod/techproject:managecriteria capability allows accessing screens for defining the assessement criteria set.

sections.title: Legacy roles settings
sections.text: Grading capabilities are only given to Teachers. Editing Teachers can moreover define criteria for grading the project. Regular Admins can do it all, as usual.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/techproject:managecriteria
sections.text:
Index
Allows defining the criteria sets applicable to a projet. A first set is global to the entire project, the latter one is applicable separately to any evaluable element within the project (milestones in version 1).

sections.title: Legacy roles settings
sections.text: Only Editing Teachers and Administrators can define the criteria sets. Students are prohibited for that capabilities.

sections.title: Capabilities/mod/techproject:viewprojectcontrols
sections.text:
Index
Allows accessing to the control screens of the project. 
Those screens allow :
* Define assessment criteria (depends on the mod/techproject:gradeproject and mod/techproject:managecriteria availability).
* Grade the project (depends on the mod/techproject:gradeproject availability).
* Controlling an external file repository (CVS)

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/category:manage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to create, update and delete course categories.
*The default role of Manager has this capability set to allow.
*This capability may only be applied in the system context, or in category context, to allow management of subcategories  
The exact rules enforced for various actions are: (Remember that the parent of a given category may be either the system context, or another category.)
# To add a new category, you need moodle/category:manage in the parent of the category you are adding to.
# To browse a category and the courses it contains, you don't normally need any special capabilities, except that
#* to view hidden courses, you need moodle/course:viewhiddencourses, and
#* to see hidden categories you need moodle/category:viewhiddencategories
# To update a category's name, description, and/or visibility, you need moodle/category:manage in the category itself.
# To move a category from one place in the tree to another, you need moodle/category:manage in both the old and new parent categories (and you are not allowed to move a category to be a descendant of itself!)
# To delete a category, you need moodle/category:manage in the parent category and the category itself. In addition, if the category or any of its subcategories contains any courses you need either:
#* moodle/course:delete in all of those courses, and moodle/category:manage in all of the child categories, or
#* moodle/course:create and moodle/category:manage in some other category that is not a child of this one. (Except that, if this category contains no sub-categories, we don't check moodle/category:manage in the other category.)
[[Category:Capabilities|Category]]

sections.title: How can I enable teachers to change the course category?
sections.text:
Normally the Teacher role is assigned in the course context i.e. you enrol a teacher in the course and give them the role of Teacher. To enable teachers to change the course category, you need to assign them a system role (or course category role) with the 'Change course category' capability allowed. This can be done by creating a custom role as follows:
# Go to ''Site administration > Users > Permissions > Define roles''.
# Click the 'Add a new role' button and give it a name.
# Select System (or Category) as context where the role may be assigned.
# Search for the capability moodle/course:changecategory and set it to Allow.
# click the 'Create this role' button.
# Next, go to ''Site administration > Users > Permissions > Assign system roles''.
#Assign your newly created role to the required teachers.
[[Category:Capabilities|Course]]
