sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/course:viewhiddensections
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view hidden sections on the Course homepage
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Course]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/course:viewhiddenuserfields
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view any hidden user fields (such as city/town, country or last access) on the course participants page
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
Note: User fields may be hidden by an administrator in ''Settings > Site administration > Users > Permissions > User policies''. None are hidden by default.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Capabilities/moodle/user:viewhiddendetails
[[Category:Capabilities|Course]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/course:viewparticipants
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view the list of participants in the course
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher and student
[[Category:Capabilities|Course]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/course:viewscales
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view scales used in a course
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher and student
[[Category:Capabilities|Scales]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/course:viewsuspendedusers
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view course participants whose enrolment status is set to suspended in the course. It only affects whether suspended users are shown on the Participants page. Suspended users are shown in many other areas in the course (MDL-35731).
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/course:visibility
sections.text:
*This allows a user to hide/unhide a course from students in the Course settings
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Course]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/filter:manage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable/disable filters in a course or activity
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Managing filters
[[Category:Capabilities|Filter]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:edit
sections.text:
* This allows a user to turn editing on/off in the Grader report in order to edit grades directly or to hide or lock individual grades.
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher and is not set for the default role of non-editing teacher.
* If not set, a user may still hide or lock Grade items via the edit categories and items page.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* mod/assignment:grade which allows a user to grade assignments via the assignments interface
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:export
sections.text:
* This allows a user to export grades of other users.
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of teacher and non-editing teacher, do NOT allow for students.
* The formats which a user is allowed to export to (Excel spreadsheet, OpenDocument spreadsheet, plain text file or XML file) are controlled by separate capabilities.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:hide
sections.text:
* This allows a user to hide/unhide individual grades.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of teacher and is not set for the default role of non-editing teacher.
*It is not necessary to allow this capability in addition to moodle/grade:manage. In other words, this capability may be used to allow a user to hide/unhide grades but not manage grades.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:import
sections.text:
*This allows a user to import grades.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of teacher and is not set for the default role of non-editing teacher.
*The formats which a user is allowed to import from (CSV or XML file) are controlled by separate capabilities.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:lock
sections.text:
*This allows a user to lock grades.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of teacher and is not set for the default role of non-editing teacher.
*It is not necessary to allow this capability in addition to moodle/grade:manage. In other words, this capability may be used to allow a user to lock grades but not manage grades.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:manage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage grade items and categories in the gradebook (create, edit, lock, hide, delete, etc.)
*This capability is allowed for the default role of teacher and is not set for the default role of non-editing teacher. 
 
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:managegradingforms
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage Advanced grading methods
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
 
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:manageletters
sections.text:
* This allows a user to edit Grade letters
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher and is not set for the default role of non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:manageoutcomes
sections.text:
* This allows a user to add outcomes either at course level in ''Settings > Course administration > Outcomes'' or for managers at site level in ''Settings > Site administration > Grades > Outcomes''
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:managesharedforms
sections.text:
* This allows a user to manage (edit / delete) advanced grading form templates, including ones originally shared by other users
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
Note: This capability must be applied via a system role, as explained in Advanced grading methods.
 
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:override
sections.text:
* This allows a user to edit or override individual grades 
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:sharegradingforms
sections.text:
* This allows a user to share an advanced grading form as a template 
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
Note: This capability must be applied via a system role, as explained in Advanced grading methods.
 
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:unlock
sections.text:
* This allows a user to unlock grades.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of teacher and is not set for the default role of non-editing teacher.
*It is not necessary to allow this capability in addition to moodle/grade:manage. In other words, this capability may be used to allow a user to unlock grades but not manage grades.
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:view
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view their own grades
* The default student role has this capability set to allow
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:viewall
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view the grades of other users, including hidden grades
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/grade:viewhidden
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view grades that are hidden
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Grade]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/h5p:deploy
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to display uploaded H5P content.
*This capability is allowed by default for managers and teachers.
*Users with h5p:deploy capability but without h5p:updatelibraries capability will be able to upload new H5P content that uses existing libraries in the site. If any of the libraries they are trying to use in the uploaded content are not available, they will see an error asking them to contact their admin to make that library available.

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/h5p:setdisplayoptions
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user set H5P display options - Allow download, Embed button and Copyright button
*This capability is allowed for the default role of teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/h5p:updatelibraries
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to manage H5P content types.
*It is  enabled by default for managers and admins, but not for teachers
*Users with h5p:deploy capability but without h5p:updatelibraries capability will be able to upload new H5P content that uses existing libraries in the site. If any of the libraries they are trying to use in the uploaded content are not available, they will see an error asking them to contact their admin to make that library available.

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/legacy:admin
sections.text:
*This is implemented for backward compatibility. It is flag to tell Moodle that this role is an admin role.
*This does NOT provide a role with all capabilities of a pre-Moodle 1.7 admin. '''All admin capabilities must be individually allowed.'''
*Note: It is not necessary to allow any legacy capabilities unless using old 3rd party code that was not designed for Moodle 1.7 and doesn't yet support roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|Legacy]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/legacy:coursecreator
sections.text:
*This is implemented for backward compatibility. It is flag to tell Moodle that this role is a "course creator" role.
*This does NOT provide a role with all capabilities of a pre-Moodle 1.7 course creator. '''All course creator capabilities must be individually allowed.'''
*Note: It is not necessary to allow any legacy capabilities unless using old 3rd party code that was not designed for Moodle 1.7 and doesn't yet support roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|Legacy]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/legacy:editingteacher
sections.text:
*This is implemented for backward compatibility. It is flag to tell Moodle that this role is a "editing teacher" role.
*This does NOT provide a role with all capabilities of a pre-Moodle 1.7 editing teacher. '''All editing teacher capabilities must be individually allowed.'''
*Note: It is not necessary to allow any legacy capabilities unless using old 3rd party code that was not designed for Moodle 1.7 and doesn't yet support roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|Legacy]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/legacy:guest
sections.text:
*This is implemented for backward compatibility. It is flag to tell Moodle that this role is a "guest" role.
*This does NOT provide a role with all capabilities of a pre-Moodle 1.7 guest. '''All guest capabilities must be individually allowed.'''
*Note: It is not necessary to allow any legacy capabilities unless using old 3rd party code that was not designed for Moodle 1.7 and doesn't yet support roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|Legacy]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/legacy:student
sections.text:
*This is implemented for backward compatibility. It is flag to tell Moodle that this role is a "student" role.
*This does NOT provide a role with all capabilities of a pre-Moodle 1.7 student. '''All student capabilities must be individually allowed.'''
*Note: It is not necessary to allow any legacy capabilities unless using old 3rd party code that was not designed for Moodle 1.7 and doesn't yet support roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|Legacy]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/legacy:teacher
sections.text:
*This is implemented for backward compatibility. It is flag to tell Moodle that this role is a "non-editing teacher" role.
*This does NOT provide a role with all capabilities of a pre-Moodle 1.7 non-editing teacher. '''All non-editing teacher capabilities must be individually allowed.'''
*Note: It is not necessary to allow any legacy capabilities unless using old 3rd party code that was not designed for Moodle 1.7 and doesn't yet support roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|Legacy]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/moodlenet:shareactivity
sections.text:
*This allows a user to share an activity or resource to an instance of MoodleNet, from the More link in an activity or resource's settings.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/moodlenet:sharecourse
sections.text:
* This allows a user to share a course to an instance of MoodleNet, from Course navigation > More > Share to MoodleNet.
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/my:configsyspages
sections.text:
* This allows a user to set which content (course overview, calendar, blocks) appears on the Dashboard for all users in ''Administration> Site administration > Appearance > Default Dashboard page''
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
[[Category:Capabilities|My]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/my:manageblocks
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage blocks (edit, add, delete, etc.) on their Dashboard
*The default authenticated user role has this capability set to allow.
*This capability can only be applied in the system context i.e. as a system role.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Dashboard for how to prevent users from customising their Dashboard
*Capabilities/moodle/site:manageblocks
[[Category:Capabilities|My]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/notes:manage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage (add, edit and delete) notes
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Notes]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/notes:view
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view Notes (assuming Notes have been enabled on your site)
*Users can only view Notes that have been created within the same context to which their Role has been assigned (e.g. Site, Course, Personal/User)
*The default Manager, Teacher and Non-Editing Teacher role has this capability set to Allow
*The default Course Creator and Student role has this capability Not Set.
* To allow user Course Creator and Students access to Notes go to Administration/Users/Permissions/Define roles and change this Capability to Allow.
* Note that an Admin, Manager or Teacher may have used the Notes functionality to create private and/or teaching notes regarding a user and changing this user's permissions will give them access to this information
[[Category:Capabilities|Notes]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/portfolio:export
sections.text:
* This allows a user to export data, such as forum posts or assignment submissions to an external portfolio
* The capability is allowed for the default roles of student, teacher and authenticated user

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Portfolios
*Capabilities/mod/workshop:exportsubmissions - for allowing users to export workshop submissions and assessments (new in 3.2)
[[Category:Capabilities|Portfolios]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:add
sections.text:
*This allows a user to add questions to a category, move questions to a category and import questions.
*This capability is checked at module / course / course category / system level depending on the where the user is attempting to create a question.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Question permissions
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:config
sections.text:
*This capability controls whether the user can manage question types available across the site in ''Settings > Site administration > Plugins > Question types > Manage question types''
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Managing questions
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:editall
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit or delete any question
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Question permissions
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:editmine
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit or delete a question they have created
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Question permissions
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:flag
sections.text:
*This allows a user to flag a question in a quiz
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher and student

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Using Quiz
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:managecategory
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage question category hierarchies i.e. creating, editing and moving categories
*The categories editing page is shown if the user has permission to edit the hierarchy in the current context or any parent context
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Question permissions
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:moveall
sections.text:
*This allows a user to move their or others' question to another category
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
Note: The user must have permission to do this in the context they are moving the question from AND have the 'add' capability in the context they are moving the question to.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/question:add
*Question permissions
    
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:movemine
sections.text:
*This allows a user to move a question they have created to another category
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
Note: The user must have permission to do this both in the context they are moving the question from and have the 'add' capability in the context to which they are moving the question.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/question:add
* See Question permissions
    
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:tagall
sections.text:
*This allows a user to tag any question.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Using tags
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:tagmine
sections.text:
*This allows a user to tag a question that they have created.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Using tags
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:useall
sections.text:
*This allows a user to preview any question and include it in a Quiz activity
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/question:viewall
*Question permissions
    
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:usemine
sections.text:
*This allows a user to preview a question they have created and include it in a Quiz activity
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/question:viewmine
*Question permissions
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:viewall
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view all questions
*This is different to the capability moodle/question:useall which only allows you to preview a question. If you can ''view'' a question it means you can see all the question answers and can also save as new question and export the question in the category
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/question:useall
*Question permissions
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/question:viewmine
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view a question they have created
*This is different to the capability moodle/question:usemine which only allows you to preview a question. If you can ''view'' a question it means you can see all the question answers and can also save as new question and export the question in the category. 
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/question:usemine
*Question permissions
[[Category:Capabilities|Question]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/rating:rate
sections.text:
*This allows a user to rate items in a course, depending upon the permission to rate items in particular activities and rating being enabled
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher, student and authenticated user
Advantages of having moodle/rating:rate AND rating capabilities for particular activities:
* The general rating caps are all on by default, so only the forum/database/glossary ones need to be toggled.
* You can turn off forum rating at the course level, independent from the database or glossary.
* You can switch all ratings on/off at the course level (without editing every single activity).
* All ratings across a course can be combined in a ratings report or activity report.
[[Category:Capabilities|Rate]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/rating:view
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view the total of their ratings for items in a course, depending upon the permission to view their ratings in particular activities
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher, student and authenticated user
[[Category:Capabilities|Rate]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/rating:viewall
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view all ratings for everyone, depending upon the permission to view all ratings in particular activities
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher, student and authenticated user
[[Category:Capabilities|Rate]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/rating:viewany
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view the total ratings for everyone, depending upon the permission to view total ratings in particular activities
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher, non-editing teacher, student and authenticated user
[[Category:Capabilities|Rate]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/reportbuilder:edit
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit Custom reports they created themselves.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only.
[[Category:Site administration]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/reportbuilder:editall
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit any report created from ''Site administration > Reports > Custom reports.''
*This capability is not set for any default roles.
[[Category:Site administration]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/reportbuilder:view
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view custom reports created from ''Site administration > Reports > Custom reports.''
*This capability is allowed for the authenticated user.
[[Category:Site administration]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/reportbuilder:viewall
sections.text:
*This allows a user to  view all Custom reports regardless of audience.
*This capability is not set for any of the default roles.

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:configure
sections.text:
*This allows a user to set options when restoring a course
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Backup]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:createuser
sections.text:
*This allows a user to create users when restoring a course
*This capability is allowed for the default manager role only

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Capabilities/moodle/restore:userinfo
[[Category:Capabilities|Restore]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:restoreactivity
sections.text:
*This allows a user to restore an activity from a backup
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher
*This capability is required in order to use the Sharing Cart plugin
[[Category:Capabilities|Backup]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:restorecourse
sections.text:
*This allows a user to restore a course
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher 
*This capability is required in order to use the Sharing Cart plugin
[[Category:Capabilities|Backup]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:restoresection
sections.text:
*This allows a user to restore course sections
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher 
*This capability is required in order to use the Sharing Cart plugin
[[Category:Capabilities|Backup]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:restoretargethub
sections.text: ''This capability is no longer used as the community finder block has been removed from Moodle 3.7.2 as part of [[Sunsetting moodle.net]].''

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:restoretargetimport
sections.text:
*This allows a user to import activities or resources from another course
*Together with the capability moodle/backup:backuptargetimport, this allows a user to duplicate an activity or resource using the x2 icon on the course page (when editing is turned on)
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Reusing activities
[[Category:Capabilities|Backup]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:rolldates
sections.text:
* This allows a user to set a new course start date when restoring a course
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and course creator
[[Category:Capabilities|Restore]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:uploadfile
sections.text:
*This allows a user to upload course backup files to the backup folder ready for restoring
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher 
[[Category:Capabilities|Backup]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:userinfo
sections.text:
*This allows a user to restore user data from a course backup, including the possible creation of new users.
*This capability is allowed for the default manager role only.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/restore:createuser 
[[Category:Capabilities|Restore]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/restore:viewautomatedfilearea
sections.text:
*This allows a user to restore courses from the automated backup storage (as specified in 'Automated backup setup' in the Site administration).
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of teacher and manager in new installs of Moodle 3.4 onwards. (Previously it was not set for any of the default roles. See MDL-35429 for further details.)

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Automated course backup
[[Category:Capabilities|Backup]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/role:assign
sections.text:
*This allows a user to assign roles in a given context (system, front page, course category or course).
*Note that to assign a role A to another user, the user  doing the assignment has to hold a role B so that role B is permitted to assign role A. This is controlled in 'Allow role assignments' in ''Settings > Site administration > Users > Permissions > Define roles''. This is logical because even though a teacher might have moodle/role:assign, in most situations we only want them to be able to assign users the student role, and not the manager role in their course.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Managing roles
[[Category:Capabilities|Role]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/role:manage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage roles i.e. create, edit, delete, change base role definitions, allow role assignments and allow role overrides.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only. It may only be applied in the site/system context i.e. as a system role.
[[Category:Capabilities|Role]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/role:override
sections.text:
* This allows a user to override the permissions of other users
* Note that to override a capability in role A, the user doing the override has to hold a role B so that role B is permitted to override role A. This is controlled in 'Allow role overrides' (via ''Settings > Site administration > Users > Permissions > Define roles'').
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Override permissions
*Allow role overrides in Managing roles
*The capability moodle/role:safeoverride
[[Category:Capabilities|Role]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/role:review
sections.text:
*This allows users to check the permissions of other users
*A teacher can check permissions for their course in ''Settings > Course administration > Users > Permissions > Check permissions'' and for a particular activity in ''Settings > Activity administration > Check permissions''
*An administrator or manager can check system permissions in ''Settings > Site administration > Users > Permissions > Check system permissions''
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher
[[Category:Capabilities|Role]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/role:safeoverride
sections.text:
* This allows a user to override capabilities that do not have major risks attached to them. Higher risk capabilities are locked (greyed out) on the override permissions page.
* Editing teacher role has this capability by default, it may be used to override Student and Non-editing teacher roles.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Allow role overrides in Managing roles
*The capability moodle/role:override
[[Category:Capabilities|Role]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/role:viewhiddenassigns
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view users with hidden role assignments.
* The default teacher and non-editing teacher roles have this capability set to allow. It is not set for the default student role.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Assign roles - Hidden assignments
[[Category:Capabilities|Role]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:accessallgroups
sections.text:
*This allows a user to access all groups in the given context (system, front page, course category or course context), irrespective of what group the user is in or whether they are in a group at all. For example, a user with this capability set to allow can browse forum postings of users in other groups when the forum is set to separate groups. 
*The default teacher role has this capability set to allow. It is not set for the non-editing teacher role.
Note: Users with a role in which moodle/course:managegroups is allowed and  moodle/site:accessallgroups is not set are able to add/delete/update groups (and groupings, if enabled) in a course.
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:approvecourse
sections.text:
*This allows a user to approve pending course requests
*This capability may only be applied as a system role
*The default manager role has this capability set to allow
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:backup
sections.text:
*This allows a user to backup a course in the context this capability applies to (system, front page, course category or course context)
*This capability is allowed for the default admin and teacher roles and is not set for the default non-editing teacher and student roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:config
sections.text:
*This allows a user to configure site settings.
*This capability is intended for administrators only. It is not set for any of the default roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]
[[Category:Site administration]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:configview
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view the site admin tree (but not pages in it)
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
[[Category:Site administration]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:deleteanymessage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to delete any message on the site.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only. It must be assigned in the system context i.e. as a system role.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Messaging
[[Category:Capabilities|Messaging]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:deleteownmessage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to delete their own messages - either messages they have sent or messages they have received. 
*The default authenticated user role has this capability set to allow.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Messaging
[[Category:Capabilities|Messaging]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:doclinks
sections.text:
*This provides a user with 'Moodle Docs for this page' links in the footer of each page for accessing context-specific documentation
*This capability is allowed for the default manager, teacher and non-editing teacher roles

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Header and footer in Site appearance
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:forcelanguage
sections.text:
* This capability allows a user to override a forced language in a course
* This capability is not set for any default role

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Capabilities/moodle/course:setforcedlanguage - capability to allow a user to force a particular language in a course
[[Category:Capabilities|Language]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:import
sections.text:
*This allows a user to import a course into the context this capability applies to (system, front page, course category or course context).
*Requires the moodle/site:backup capability enabled.
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:langeditlocal
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit files saved in the local languages folder ''moodledata/lang/lang_utf8_local/''
*It may only be applied as a global role
*This capability is set to ''Allow'' by default for the administrator role

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Language editing
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:langeditmaster
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit master language packs i.e. those saved in ''moodledata/lang/''.
*This capability is intended for language maintainers only. It may only be applied as a system role.
*By default, the admin role has this capability set to prevent.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Language editing
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:maintenanceaccess
sections.text:
*This allows a user to access the site whilst it is in Maintenance mode
*This capability is not set for any of the default roles
[[Category:Site administration]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:manageallmessaging
sections.text:
*This allows a user to add, remove, block and unblock contacts for any user
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Messaging
[[Category:Capabilities|Messaging]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:manageblocks
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage blocks (edit, add, delete, etc.) in the context this capability applies to (system, front page or course context)
*For example, a user assigned to the default "editing teacher" role will have this capability set in the course context, thus enabling them to manage blocks in the course context
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/my:manageblocks
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:managecontextlocks
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to use the experimental feature Context freezing to make categories, blocks, courses or course content 'read only'.
*This capability is not set for any of the default roles.
*This capability may be applied in the course, course category or system context.
[[Category:Capabilities|Context freezing]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:messageanyuser
sections.text:
* This allows a user to send a message to any user regardless of their messaging privacy settings i.e. they can send a message to a user who has blocked them. 
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher.
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:mnetlogintoremote
sections.text:
*This allows a user to roam to another Moodle site which is part of a Moodle network.
*By default, the capability is not set for any role. It should be allowed for an appropriate role, such as student, when setting up a Moodle Network.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*MNet
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:readallmessages
sections.text:
*This allows a user to read all instant messages
*This capability may only be applied in the system context
*The default manager role has this capability set to allow
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:sendmessage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to send messages to any other user
*This capability may only  be applied in the system context
*The default authenticated user role has this capability set to allow

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Messaging FAQ for details of how to use this capability to restrict messaging
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:trustcontent
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enter JavaScript and other tags into places where all text is normally cleaned
*To make use of this capability, trusted content must first be enabled via ''Site administration > Security > Site security settings''
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Risks
*[[dev:Trusttext cleaning bypass]]
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:uploadusers
sections.text:
*This allows a user to upload users via text file in ''Site administration > Users > Accounts > Upload users''
*This capability is allowed for the default manager role only
*This capability can only be applied in the system context i.e. via a system role
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:usewebservices
sections.text:
*This allows a user to make use of Web Services in Moodle.
[[Category:Capabilities|Webservice]]
[[Category:Web Services]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:viewanonymousevents
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view anonymous events in log reports, such as when a student makes an Assignment submission with Anonymous submissions enabled
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only. It may be applied in the site, course or activity context.
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:viewfullnames
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view the full names of other users.
*This capability is only applicable if the full name format is set to 'firstname' or another option in which the full name is not displayed in ''Administration > Site administration > Users > Permissions > User policies''. In this case, a user with a role in which this capability is not set, e.g. a student, can only view the first names of other users. A user with a role in which this capability is allowed, e.g. a teacher, can view the full names of other users.
*Preventing or prohibiting this capability does not result in full names of other users not being displayed at all. If the full name format is set to firstname then a user with a role in which this capability is prevented or prohibited can only view the first names of other users.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher.
* The setting 'Alternative full name format' enables admins to define how names are shown to users with the view full names capability.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Additional name fields
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:viewparticipants
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view the list of course participants when they are not enrolled in the course
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:viewreports
sections.text:
*This allows users to access reports such as Logs, Activity report and Course participation, depending on view report permissions, via ''Navigation > Course > Reports''
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Course reports
[[Category:Capabilities|Site]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/site:viewuseridentity
sections.text:
* This allows a user to view fields such as ID number and email address (as selected in 'Show user identity' in ''Settings > Site administration > Users > Permissions > User policies'') when searching for users and displaying lists of users, for example when adding users to groups and in the grader report
* This also allows a user to view a student's email on their profile page (if email is selected as one of the fields in Show user identity)
* This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Roles settings for further details of the 'Show user identity' setting
[[Category:Capabilities|View]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/tag:create
sections.text: [[Category:Capabilities|Tag]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/tag:edit
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit a tag to add a description and related tags.
* Only the  default Manager role has this capability set to allow. (Note that prior to 3.0 the default was authenticated user).
* This capability may only be applied in the system context i.e. as a system role
[[Category:Capabilities|Tag]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/tag:editblocks
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit blocks in tag pages
*The default manager, teacher and non-editing teacher roles have this capability set to allow
*This capability may only be applied in the system context i.e. as a system role
[[Category:Capabilities|Tag]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/tag:flag
sections.text:
* This allows a user to flag a tag as inappropriate
* The default authenticated user role has this capability set to allow
* This capability may only be applied in the system context i.e. as a system role
* Only user with capability moodle/tag:manage can reset the flag or remove the tag
[[Category:Capabilities|Tag]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/tag:manage
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage tags via ''Site administration > Appearance > Manage tags''.
*This allows the user to delete existing tags, see which tags have been flagged as inappropriate and who created each tag.
*Only the default Manager role has this capability set to allow. The capability should be given to people responsible for maintaining good use of the tags functionality.
*This capability may only be applied in the system context i.e. as a system role.
[[Category:Capabilities|Tag]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:changeownpassword
sections.text:
*This allows a user to change their own password.
*The capability only applies in the system context i.e. it must be set for a system role, such as authenticated user.
*The default authenticated user role has this capability set to allow. It is prohibited for the guest role.

sections.title: Example usage
sections.text: *Demo teacher role

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/user:editownprofile
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:create
sections.text:
*This allows a user to create new users
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
* It may only be applied in the system context i.e. as a global role
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:delete
sections.text:
*This allows a user to delete other user accounts
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
*It may only be applied in the system context i.e. as a global role

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Managing accounts
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:editmessageprofile
sections.text:
*This allows a user to set the destination for incoming messages for other users in Moodle.
*The default Manager role has this capability set to allow.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*moodle/user:editownmessageprofile
[[Category:Capabilities|Messaging]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:editownmessageprofile
sections.text:
*This allows a user to set the destination for their incoming messages in Moodle.
*The default Authenticated user role has this capability set to allow.
[[Category:Capabilities|Messaging]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:editownprofile
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit their own profile.
*The default Authenticated user role has this capability set to allow.
*Since user profiles are outside courses, changing [[Capabilities/moodle/user:editownprofile]] for the student role (normally given in a course) won't work. It should be changed for a system-wide role, such as the Authenticated user role, or in a new role, such as Restricted user as described in Demo teacher role.

sections.title: Example usage
sections.text: *Demo teacher role

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*User profiles
Using Moodle forum discussions:
*How do you stop users (students) from editing their profiles? for an alternative method
*Unable to stop users editing their profile
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:editprofile
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit another user's profile details. 
*Only the default Manager role has this capability set to allow.
*This capability can be applied in the system context i.e. via a system role.
*This capability can be applied in a user to user role such as the Parent role.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*User profiles
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:manageblocks
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage the blocks which appear on the user profile page of other users
*By default only the Administrator can do this; the capability is not set for any other role

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*User profiles
[[Category:Capabilities|Block]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:manageownblocks
sections.text:
*This allows a user to manage blocks (edit, add, delete, etc.) on their public profile page.
*The default authenticated user role has this capability set to allow.
*This capability can only be applied in the system context i.e. as a system role.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*User profiles
[[Category:Capabilities|Block]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:manageownfiles
sections.text:
* This allows a user to manage their Private files via their dashboard or the Private files block
* This capability is allowed for the default role of authenticated user

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Private files
* The capability View user private files
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:managesyspages
sections.text:
* This allows a user to set which blocks appear on the default profile page for new users in ''Settings > Site administration > Appearance > Default profile page''
* This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:readuserblogs
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view the blogs of other users.
*The capability is set to allow by default for the Manager, Teacher, Non-editing teacher and Student role. (It is not set for Guests and Course Creators.)
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:readuserposts
sections.text:
*This allows a user to see user forum posts.
*The capability is set to allow by default for the Manager, Teacher, Non-editing teacher and Student role. (It is not set for Guests and  Course Creators) 
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:update
sections.text:
*This allows a user to update another user's profile i.e. in addition to being able to edit the profile, all settings (username, password, authentication method, force new password etc.) may be changed. This can be done via ''Settings > Site administration > Users > Accounts > Browse list of users'' or via the [[User profiles |profile page]] of an individual user.
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only.
* This capability can only be applied in the system context i.e. via a system role.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/user:editprofile
*Using Moodle Is there an appropriate context for selective user profile editing? forum discussion
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:viewalldetails
sections.text:
*This allows a user to see additional information on users' profile pages.
*Only the default Manager role has this capability set to allow.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*Capabilities/moodle/user:viewhiddendetails which allows a user to see any hidden user fields.
*Capabilities/moodle/user:viewdetails
*User profiles
* MDL-63296 - report of certain optional profile fields such as phone not being displayed on the profile page
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:viewdetails
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view another user's profile page
*If the capability is applied at the course level, for example a user is enrolled in a course as a student or teacher, then the user can view other users' course profile pages
*If the capability is applied at the system level, for example a user has the system role of manager, then the user can view full profile pages
*This capability is allowed for all default roles except the authenticated user role
{|
|-
| 
| 
|-
|}

sections.title: Example usage
sections.text:
*Parent role
*On moodle.org, this capability is allowed for the authenticated user role so that logged-in users can view the profiles of users participating in front page activities such as the Moodle Jobs database.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
*View profile
*Capabilities/moodle/user:viewalldetails
*Mentees block
*User profiles
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:viewhiddendetails
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view any hidden user fields (such as description, city/town, country, web page, ICQ number, Skype ID, Yahoo ID, AIM ID, MSN ID and last access) on users' profile pages.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, teacher and non-editing teacher roles and is not set for all other roles.
Note: User fields may be hidden by an administrator in ''Administration > Users > Permissions > User policies''. None are hidden by default.

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Capabilities/moodle/course:viewhiddenuserfields
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:viewlastip
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to view the last IP field in user profiles.
*It is set to 'Allow' for the default role of manager only and is not set for other roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]
[[Category:Site administration]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:viewprofilepictures
sections.text:
This capability allows a user to view the profile pictures of others if force log in is enabled.
It is allowed for the default roles of authenticated user and Guest.

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:viewuseractivitiesreport
sections.text:
*This allows a user to view the activities reports of a user via their profile.
*This capability is not set for the Manager, Teacher and Non-editing teacher roles.
[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/user:viewusergrades
sections.text: *This allows a user to view user grades in a course

[[Category:Capabilities|User]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/webservice:createmobiletoken
sections.text:
*This allows a user to create a Web services token for mobile access
*This capability is allowed for the default role of authenticated user
[[Category:Capabilities|Webservice]]
[[Category:Web Services]]

sections.title: Capabilities/moodle/webservice:createtoken
sections.text:
*This allows a user to create a security key, also known as a token
*This capability is allowed for the default role of manager only
[[Category:Capabilities|Webservice]]
[[Category:Web Services]]

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:bypassseb
sections.text:
*This allows a user to bypass the requirement to view a quiz using the Safe Exam Browser.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and teacher.
[[Category:Capabilities|Quiz]]

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage filemanager sebconfigfile
sections.text: *This allows a user to select a Safe Exam Browser config file to be used with a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb activateurlfiltering
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable or disable URL filtering to be used with a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb allowedbrowserexamkeys
sections.text:
*This allows a user to modify the allowed Browser Exam Keys to be used with a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb allowreloadinexam
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable/disable the possibility for students to allow reload the page within a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb allowspellchecking
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable/disable spell checking within a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb allowuserquitseb
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable/disable the possibility for students to quit a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb configuremanually
sections.text:
*This capability allows a user to configure Safe Exam Browser manually, without using a template.
*It is allowed for the default roles of Manager and Teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb enableaudiocontrol
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable/disable the UI element to control the audio in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb expressionsallowed
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit the simple expressions for allowed URL in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb expressionsblocked
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit the simple expressions for blocked URL in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb filterembeddedcontent
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable/disable whether embedded content is verified against allowing/blocking URL rules in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb linkquitseb
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable/disable the "Exit Safe Exam Browser" button in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb muteonstartup
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable that the audio is initially muted in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb quitpassword
sections.text:
*This allows a user to set a quit password for a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb regexallowed
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit the regular expressions for allowed URL in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb regexblocked
sections.text:
*This allows a user to edit the regular expressions for blocked URL in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb requiresafeexambrowser
sections.text:
*This allows a user to set whether a quiz should have the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb showkeyboardlayout
sections.text:
*This allows a user ti enable/disable the UI element to control the keyboard layout in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb showreloadbutton
sections.text:
*This allows a user ti enable/disable the reload page UI element in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb showsebdownloadlink
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable the display of the "Download Safe Exam Browser" button before a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb showsebtaskbar
sections.text:
*This allows a user ti enable/disable the task bar UI in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb showtime
sections.text:
*This allows a user ti enable/disable the display of the clock UI element a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb showwificontrol
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable/disable the UI element to control the Wi-Fi in a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb templateid
sections.text:
*This allows a user to choose from a Safe Exam Browser config template for a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb userconfirmquit
sections.text:
*This allows a user to enable/disable whether users have to confirm your wish of quitting a quiz which has the use of Safe Exam Browser required.
*This capability is allowed for the default roles of manager, and editing teacher.

sections.title: Capabilities/quizaccess/seb:manage seb usesebclientconfig

* This capability is not included in any role by default, but it can be added if required, including the "Authenticated user" and "Guest" roles. This is a common use case when certificates verification has to be performed by the non-authenticated users.

sections.title: Capabilities/tool/dataprivacy:downloadallrequests
sections.text:
* This allows a user to download other users' exported data. 
* This capability is not set for any of the default roles. It may only be applied in the system context i.e. as a system role.
* This capability is available in Moodle 3.5.2 onwards.
Organisations with multiple systems and a centralised request process can prevent users from downloading their own data (by removing the capability Download your own exported data for the authenticated user role)  and instead enable a privacy officer to download it for them (by allowing this capability for the Privacy officer role).

sections.title: See also
sections.text:
* Data privacy
[[Category:Capabilities|Privacy]]

Organisations with multiple systems and a centralised request process can prevent users from downloading their own data (by removing this capability for the authenticated user role)  and instead enable a privacy officer to download it for them (by allowing the capability Download exported data for everyone for the Privacy officer role).

sections.title: Learning Catalogue Overview
sections.text: The learning catalogue contains all courses available in your Moodle Workplace tenant. Once enabled, it can be accessed via the top-level '''Catalogue''' menu item or directly via https:///course. The catalogue comprises two different pages: # '''Main page''' This is the main view when navigating to the catalogue. It shows all courses available to the current user. # '''Results page''' The results are shown once a category has been selected or a search has been executed. The filter sidebar, if configured, displayed on the left, lets you narrow down the course search.

sections.title: Learning catalogue main page
sections.text:
The following is an annotated view of the learning catalogue’s main page:
* The '''category selector''' lets you choose a single category or sub-category. Once selected, the results page will be displayed. The number of category levels shown can be specified in the [[Catalogue#Learning catalogue settings|learning catalogue settings]].
* The '''catalogue search''' lets you narrow down the search using Moodle’s standard search operators. Once executed, the results page will be displayed.
* The '''course cards''' show details about each course. The attributes displayed, depend on the [[Catalogue#Learning catalogue settings|learning catalogue settings]].
If the number of courses exceeds the number specified in the [[Catalogue#Learning catalogue settings|learning catalogue settings]], the page navigation is shown at the bottom of the catalogue.

sections.title: Learning catalogue results page
sections.text:
The results page is shown if one of the following two actions has been carried out:
* A search has been executed using the catalogue search
* A category or sub-category has been selected
The following is an annotated view of the learning catalogue’s results page:
* The '''category selector''' lets you choose a single category or sub-category. Once selected, the results page will be refreshed.
* The '''catalogue search''' lets you narrow down the search using Moodle’s standard search operators. Once executed, the results page will be displayed.
* The '''course cards''' show details about each course. The attributes shown, depend on the [[Catalogue#Learning catalogue settings|learning catalogue settings]].
* The filter lets you narrow down the shown results further. There are up to three types of filters that will be displayed:
** '''Subcategory filter''': If the shown courses are spread across multiple courses or the selected category contains sub-categories, these will be available for selection. If more than 5 subcategories are available, a '''Show more''' link lets users display all categories.
** '''Tags filter''': If any of the shown results contain any course tags, these will be available for selection. If more than 5 tags are available, a '''Show more''' link lets users display all tags.
** '''User-defined course fields filter''': If any of the shown results contain any course user-defined course fields, these will be available for selection. If more than 5 fields are available, a '''Show more''' link lets users display all course fields. In the screenshot above, the Level attribute is a user-defined course field.
The filters available to users and the order in which they are arranged can be specified in filter section of the [[Catalogue#Fields to display in the learning catalogue filter|catalogue configuration]].

sections.title: Course cards
sections.text:
Course cards show details about each course. While course cards on the main page look slightly different from course cards on the results page, they can both show the same fields. The attributes displayed, depend on the [[Catalogue#Fields to display in the 'list' (detailed) view of learning catalogue|catalogue configuration]] and can differ for each course card type.

sections.title: Enabling / Disabling the Learning Catalogue
sections.text: The learning catalogue is disabled by default. To change this setting, navigate to '''Learning > Learning catalogue settings''' and tick the '''Enable learning catalogue''' option. Alternatively, you can permanently enable the learning catalogue by adding the following setting to your config.php: $CFG->tool_catalogue = true; Once the catalogue has been enabled, all catalogue settings will be shown.

sections.title: Catalogue Settings
sections.text:
To configure the learning catalogue, either navigate to '''Learning > Default settings > Learning catalogue settings''' or select the catalogue icon from the Workplace Launcher.]]Here, you will find the following sections:
# '''Learning catalogue settings''': Generic settings impacting the entire catalogue
# '''Fields to display in the 'tiles' (compact) view''' '''of learning catalogue''': Fields shown on the main page
# '''Fields to display in the 'list' (detailed) view of learning catalogue''': Fields shown on the results page
# '''Fields to display in the learning catalogue filter''': Fields shown in the filter pane
The four areas are described in detail in the following subsections:

sections.title: Learning catalogue settings
sections.text: The following options are available in the learning catalogue settings: * '''Enable learning catalogue''': see dedicated section above * '''Number of courses per page, site home page''': Maximum number of courses shown on the [[Catalogue#Making the Learning Catalogue Public|public learning catalogue]]. If the number exceeds the number of courses to be shown, the page navigator will be made available. * '''Number of courses per page, main catalogue page''': Maximum number of courses shown on the main page. If the number exceeds the number of courses to be shown, the page navigator will be made available. * '''Number of courses per page, search results''': Maximum number of courses shown on the results page. If the number exceeds the number of courses to be shown, the page navigator will be made available. * '''Maximum number of same-level categories''': Specifies the maximum number of same-level categories shown in the category selector. Categories will be displayed in the same order as they have been defined in the course management page. Categories exceeding this maximum number will be hidden, but courses will appear in the search results. * '''Maximum number of nested category levels''': Specifies the maximum number of nested category levels in the category selector. Categories below this level will be hidden, but courses will appear in the search results. * '''Safe HTML tags in summary and text fields''': List of the HTML tags that will be kept when displaying text fields (course summary and course custom fields). This might conflict with “'''Truncate course summary'''”. * '''Truncate course summary''': Number of characters shown in the course summary. This might conflict with “'''Safe HTML tags in summary and text fields'''”. Set 0 for no truncation. * '''Course search method:''' The '''Simple Search''' option is very similar to the existing course search method in Moodle LMS. It simply searches for course fullname, course shortname and course summary, giving priority to fullname and shortname. '''Extended search''' can be customised to search in course custom fields, categories, tags and trainers. {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="1" rowspan="1" | ! colspan="1" rowspan="1" |'''Simple Search''' ! colspan="1" rowspan="1" |'''Extended Search''' |- | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Case-sensitivity | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |no | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |yes |- | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Support for wildcards (% and _) | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |yes | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |yes |- | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Requires cron process | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |no | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |yes |- | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Uses index | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |no (on-the-fly search) | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |yes (must be built before first use) |- | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Supports field selection | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |no | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |yes |- | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Supports field prioritisation | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |no | colspan="1" rowspan="1" |yes |} '''Note''': when you switch from Simple search to Extended search, you need to save changes before the '''[[Catalogue#Fields to search for keywords|Fields to search for keywords]]''' section will be shown. The new search API allows connecting more search methods using hooks and may be potentially configured to use external search engines such as Solr or Typesense.

sections.title: Fields to display in the 'tiles' (compact) view of the learning catalogue
sections.text:
In this section, you can configure which fields are shown in cards on the catalogue’s main page. There are two types of fields you can select:
# Built-in course fields: Standard course fields, namely Course summary, Course category, Tags, Start date, and End date.
# Course custom fields: Fields which have been added via '''Learning > Default settings > Course custom fields''' (all custom type fields are supported). If the visibility of a field is set to '''Trainers''' or '''Nobody''', the field can still be shown in the learning catalogue. However, a warning icon is displayed in the configuration, indicating that ''“This field has restricted visibility on the course information and enrolment pages, however it can still be made available in the learning catalogue. If enabled here, the field will be visible to everybody.”''
In the '''Display field name''' column, you can specify whether the field label is shown or hidden. By default, the '''Name''' of the field is displayed, which you can override via the '''Edit''' action.
Any fields of type Text area, whether built-in or custom, have an additional setting '''Allow HTML tags''' with the options '''Only safe HTML tags''' (default), '''Allow any HTML tags''' (no filtering), and '''Strip all HTML tags''' (full filtering).
The order of the fields shown in the compact view can be arranged via the up and down arrows in the '''Order''' column.
